messages:
becky: Quick one  async python client failing TLS when we go through corp proxy + custom CA for our Dedicated base_url. Sync client is fine. Anyone hit this?
owen: What exception? Can you paste the tiny repro and env?
becky: Trace: `ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate`
becky: Repro (async, using httpx backend):
```python
import os
from redwood import AsyncClient

c = AsyncClient(
    base_url="https://dedicated.internal",
    api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"),
    verify="/opt/certs/company-root.pem"
)
await c.generate("ping")
```
becky: Env: `HTTPS_PROXY=http://corp-proxy:3128`, `REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/opt/certs/company-root.pem`. If I unset HTTPS_PROXY the call works.
jules: Huh. httpx/aiohttp may ignore `verify` when proxy transport is created unless you pass an ssl.SSLContext. Also some proxies do TLS interception and present their own cert chain.
owen: Our AsyncClient code path only forwards verify as-is for sync. For async we construct an httpx.AsyncClient with `proxies=...` and don't set `trust_env=False` which can pick up conflicting env. Also we don't accept an `ssl_context` param. Bug.
marta: I'm filing redwood/devex#2187 1: "async sdk: proxy env + verify path ignored, cause cert verification failures". Adding integration test.
deploy-bot: integration job #4521 failed: flaky `test_async_proxy_ca` on linux/arm64.
becky: Short term I worked around it by creating an SSLContext and setting `SSL_CERT_FILE` in Dockerfile: `ENV SSL_CERT_FILE=/opt/certs/company-root.pem`. That fixed openssl for the interpreter.
owen: Another confirm command you can run from the container: `python -c "import ssl; print(ssl.get_default_verify_paths())"` and `openssl s_client -showcerts -connect dedicated.internal:443 -CAfile /opt/certs/company-root.pem`.
marta: Plan: (1) expose `ssl_context` in AsyncClient init; (2) when proxies are used, ensure we preserve `base_url` and Host header; (3) set `trust_env=False` by default or document a clear proxy+CA setup.
jules: Also add an example in devex sample apps showing how to create the SSLContext and pass it, and a dockerfile snippet to install the CA into system store.
becky: I'll attach the dockerfile + `openssl s_client` output to the GH issue and try the SSL_CERT_FILE mount until the SDK change lands. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
